name: Fuchs & Hase
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Fuchs & Hase in Innsbruck**

Discover a cozy retreat in the heart of **Innsbruck**, where traditional Tyrolean charm meets modern comfort. Our family-run guesthouse invites you to unwind in a warm, homely atmosphere, surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of the **Alps**.

**Enjoy our Tyrolean hospitality** with hearty breakfasts featuring fresh bread, homemade jams, and local specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn** or **Speckknödel**. Whether you're exploring the historic old town, hiking in the **Karwendel** mountains, or skiing in **Nordkette**, our central location makes every adventure effortless.

**Relax in our rustic yet stylish rooms**, each offering stunning views of **Innsbruck**’s rooftops or the majestic **Nordkette**. Free Wi-Fi, a cozy lounge, and a terrace with mountain vistas ensure a perfect stay.

**Experience the best of Tirol**—from alpine hikes to cultural gems—all just steps from your door. **Willkommen in Innsbruck!**
